features.name: Create Task
features.description: Users can add a new task with a title and optional description.
user_stories: As a user, I can create a task with a title so that I can record work I need to do.
As a user, I can add an optional description so that I can capture task details.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the task list, When I submit a valid title, Then the new task appears in my list as incomplete.
Given I am creating a task, When I submit an empty title, Then I see a validation error and no task is created.

features.name: Complete Task
features.description: Users can mark a task as complete or revert it to incomplete.
user_stories: As a user, I can mark a task as complete so that I can track my progress.
As a user, I can unmark a completed task so that I can correct mistakes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an incomplete task, When I mark it complete, Then it is shown as completed and the status is saved.
Given a completed task, When I unmark it, Then it returns to incomplete status and the change persists after reload.

features.name: Delete Task
features.description: Users can permanently delete tasks they no longer need.
user_stories: As a user, I can delete a task so that my list only contains relevant items.
As a user, I can confirm before deleting so that I avoid removing tasks by accident.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing task, When I confirm deletion, Then the task is removed from my list and the database.
Given a deletion prompt, When I cancel, Then the task remains unchanged in my list.

features.name: View Task List
features.description: Users can view all their tasks and filter by completion status.
user_stories: As a user, I can view all my tasks so that I know what is pending.
As a user, I can filter tasks by status so that I can focus on open or finished items.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have tasks, When I open the app, Then I see my tasks listed with title and status.
Given I select the Completed filter, When the list refreshes, Then only completed tasks are displayed.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Task list pages load in under 2 seconds at 100 concurrent users.
The service maintains at least 99.5% monthly uptime.
A new user can create and complete a task within 1 minute without instructions.
All traffic uses HTTPS and users can only access their own tasks.
